name: Gemini Credit Card

apr.notes: 16.49% to 34.49% variable APR based on creditworthiness. Penalty APR up to 33.49%. Maximum APR 35.99%. Per Cardholder Agreement dated 2026-04-01. APR not re-verified from page on 2026-07-24 (support page returned 403). Preserved from prior verification.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Stated on product page: 'No foreign transaction fees'.

credit_required.notes: Typically good to excellent credit. Wide APR range (16.49-34.49%) suggests acceptance across a broad credit spectrum. Score band not explicitly stated on product page; preserved from prior verification.

base_rate.description: 1% back in crypto on all other qualifying purchases (Everything else 1% crypto back).

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards earned in cryptocurrency (bitcoin or 50+ cryptos on Gemini) and instantly deposited into Gemini account. Change crypto reward selection at any time. 4% gas/transit category limited to $300/month, then 1% thereafter. 10% back available at select merchants through Gemini Merchant Reward Program.

benefits.title: Instant Crypto Rewards Deposit
benefits.description: Rewards are instantly deposited into Gemini account. Some exclusions apply to instant rewards in which rewards are deposited when the transaction posts.

benefits.title: Flexible Crypto Reward Selection
benefits.description: Earn bitcoin or 50+ cryptos available on Gemini. Easily change the crypto you want to earn, as often as you want.

benefits.title: 10% Back at Select Merchants
benefits.description: Earn 10% Back on the Internet's Favorite Brands. 10% Vault Rewards are available on up to a limited value in spend per month and varies depending on the merchant offer.

benefits.title: Credit Card Referral Program
benefits.description: Get $50 in crypto for each referral and an extra $250 bonus each time you make 5 referrals. Up to 50 referrals per year (up to $5,000 in crypto).

benefits.title: Mastercard World Elite
benefits.description: Mastercard World Elite benefits. Stated on product page: 'Mastercard® World Elite'.

notes: Gemini Credit Card issued by WebBank. Mastercard World Elite. No annual fee, no foreign transaction fees. 4% crypto back on Gas/EV/Transit (up to $300/month), 3% Dining, 2% Groceries, 1% everything else. Rewards in bitcoin or 50+ cryptos, instantly deposited. APR values preserved from prior verification (support page returned 403 on 2026-07-24).
